paper_title: Search for light scalar Dark Matter candidate with AURIGA detector
coupling_convention: d_g (dimensionless scalar coupling to baryonic matter), as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper constrains scalar field (moduli) coupling to ordinary matter via oscillations of atomic size. The coupling parameter d_e (electromagnetic gauge modulus) or d_me (electron mass modulus) is constrained. The abstract states 'd_e ≲ 10^-5 around masses m_φ = 3.6·10^-12 eV'. The paper discusses both d_me and d_e couplings (Eqs. 1-2), and the final result in Fig. 5 shows upper limits on 'd_i' where d_i can be either d_me or d_e. The coupling is to ordinary matter (nucleons/baryons) via the variation of fundamental constants. Classified as ScalarBaryon because the interaction is fundamentally with baryonic matter through the moduli field affecting atomic structure. The DM density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm³ is explicitly stated as the Standard Halo Model assumption. Single data point extracted from abstract; Fig. 5 shows the exclusion curve but precise numerical values across the full mass range are not tabulated in the text. The 95% C.L. is explicitly stated.
